name: ref-ll-set
meaning: opt.LL=1 widens the length field to u32, which a PATH_REF body can never need: 255 elements is 2040 bytes, three orders inside a u16. RFC-0024 §4.2 forbids the bit rather than ignoring it, so one route has one byte spelling; a set LL is tr::frame::invalid. A successful decode of this frame is a conformance FAILURE.
